So far the entirety of the revealed members are female.

Legacy - Pauline "Felicia" Parsons leading her own team.

Muse - Young Vanessa Long making projections, coming into her own, and doing psychic stuff.

Aeon Girl - Being ridiculously powerful, but having no idea how her powers work, how to control herself, or even who she is as a person.

Rockstar - No information.

Unrevealed member - No information

So far, it looks like Daybreak focuses a lot more on using raw power creatively as opposed to the Freedom Five team who were much more focused on using super technology to win the day.

That’s a good guess. We know more Virtuosos will be coming out of the woodwork. Maybe an alien Virtuoso (to put the “star” in more modestly)? Otherwise I was thinking a Magmarian (because they’re made of rock).

Tempest’s offspring would be my best guess for the fifth spot. They’ll be about the right age. Not female, but not male either, and we don’t know that Rockstar is, either.

As for “related to existing heroes,” it’s hard to avoid. The lore is so dense that I imagine most new heroes and villains will have ties to existing ones, one way or another.
